scope: partners at Contract signed or later; earlier-stage prospects are kept out of this public file

stages.name: Sourced
stages.exit_criteria: Publisher identified and logged with source channel and region.

stages.name: Outreach - contacting
stages.exit_criteria: First outreach sent; keep chasing (log each touch in Follow-ups #, update Last Contacted & Next Action).

stages.name: Responded
stages.exit_criteria: They replied / showed interest; set up the scoping call.

stages.name: Scoping call scheduled
stages.exit_criteria: Intro/scoping call booked on the calendar.

stages.name: Scoping call done
stages.exit_criteria: Capabilities scoped (inventory, regions, formats, pricing model).

stages.name: Qualified (programmatic)
stages.exit_criteria: Confirmed programmatic-capable -> proceed to contract. If not, mark 'Not pursued'.

stages.name: In redlines
stages.exit_criteria: Redlines under discussion with both legal teams.

stages.name: Dashboard access granted
stages.exit_criteria: Vendor/account set up; dashboard access provided.

stages.name: Test campaign allocated
stages.exit_criteria: Test campaign(s) assigned to validate delivery & CPA.

stages.name: Live
stages.exit_criteria: Campaign live on them — loop closed. Add to performance tracking.

stages.name: Not pursued
stages.exit_criteria: Dropped at any stage (no fit / no response / not programmatic). Record why in Notes.
